title: RikaNV · сравнение прицельных сеток

rico3.method: Exact ARM64 cross_paint emulation with native host Qt5 raster primitive bridge; not a device screenshot.

limits: Shape comparison only: cropped previews use independent fit scales. No common angular calibration or cross-model mil equality is implied.
Rasterization is performed on the host, not captured from a physical scope. No device access or firmware change.
RICO 3 H50R stock UI types 1–7 only, white/red palette at zoom 1; configurable internal type 7 is not a fixed stock design and is not included. H50RPro and other RICO generations are excluded.

LPR active Canvas types 0–7 are distinct from legacy PNGs whose Image widget is commented out. Type 8 is configurable: two examples use source defaults; persisted user configurations are not recovered.

DBH menu background PNGs are byte-identical in D12/D6, but executed reticle geometry differs: independent D12 and D6 variants are shown. Rounding, font and host raster effects are not device-verified.

Kaban JSON is the source of truth. Marks 1–6 are nominal stock catalog geometry, mark5 includes the authored perpendicular strokes of ADR-0080; Kedr mark7 and mil-cross mark8 are authored. Only Kaban PN 509–512, not Moskit PN 502/504.

Kaban PNGs render catalog geometry without the firmware night-vision outline, scene, ballistic marker, or hardware projection. Native-buffer coordinates and the catalog K1 are used, not the legacy 800px simulated preview surface.
